steps.speaker: Roxanne
steps.content: This area has been evacuated. Barricades have been set up at all openings.

An area is cleared out in an alley within this street block. In the center lies your personal device. You specifically got an extra sturdy model with a large screen this time, hoping it can last a bit longer.
No one can tell how such a massive volume of votes will manifest physically. Even you can't claim to have the confidence to resist this power.
Everyone stands by at the closest possible position in case they need to join the battle, waiting for you to open Pandora's box.
You stand closest to the device, looking down as the numbers on the screen change while counting down.

Digitalized Corruptors swarm out and are immediately restrained by the combat team. Your colleagues are doing their best to buy you time. You no longer stare at the monsters, focusing instead on your poor device.

Carefully observing through the stream of Corruptors, on the broken screen glowing with eerie light, you finally see the hidden familiar symbol: the distorted single eye from the dark world below. The entrance to the Underground's space sorcery!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Leave the monsters to us! But our men here may not be able to hold it for long if the opening lasts! Please be quick!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've hold it for long enough.

A spike of red light pierces through the center of the sorcery. Maddening mental contamination sweeps through your brain. Your head hurts. Your ears ring. Your vision shakes violently. In a daze, you begin to see the golden runes enlarging, like a giant door cracking open to swallow you...
